# Red Apple Distribution

> Red Apple Distribution is a wholesale distributor for US licensed smoke shops and retailers. Wholesale only, sold to licensed retailers, 21+. The products are targeted at the United States only; we do not ship overseas.

## What we sell
Wholesale categories: vapes, flower, hydroxys, edibles, pre-rolls, kratom, shrooms and smoke accessories. Brands carried include Geek Bar, Lost Mary, RAZ, Fogger, Viva La Hemp, Muha Meds, Dozo and Mellow Fellow, among others listed on the brands page.

## How ordering works
- There is no online checkout and no card or bank details are taken on the website. Retailers build a list and request a quote; the sales team replies with terms.
- Bulk quotes start at 10 boxes.
- Shipping is by FedEx and UPS, within the United States.
- If an order arrives damaged or duplicated, a credit is issued after the issue is verified with the shipping partner and the vendor.
- Prices are given on request through a quote, not published on the site.
